summary: Read one selected Apple Mail message without mutation
description: Prerequisites: T001-contracts and T002-mail-link. Add a bounded JXA adapter that snapshots exactly one selected message and exposes only the fields required by the domain contract.
acceptance: The constant JXA program reads selection metadata only and contains no Mail mutation verbs or dynamically injected mail content.
Zero, one, multiple, malformed, timeout, and oversized-output paths fail with typed redacted outcomes.
